title: Engage with Redwire at the Space Defense & Security Summit in Paris
summary: Visit the Redwire stand to learn more about Phantom, Redwire’s European VLEO platform, and other critical European-built, flight-proven technology supporting game-changing space missions.
body_markdown:
Visit the Redwire stand to learn more about[Phantom](https://rdw.com/capabilities/phantom/) , Redwire’s European VLEO platform, and other critical European-built, flight-proven technology supporting game-changing space missions. See below for speaking engagements and more event information.


**Wednesday, September 16, 2026**


2:55 p.m.-3:45-p.m.


Les Salon Hoche


**Panel:**[Designing the Future Secure and Military Space Systems Development](https://sds-summit.com/speakers/juan-pablo-ramos/)


Speakers:


- Juan Pablo Ramos, Head of Defence and Security Programmes, Redwire


- Luigi Pozzebon, Vice President of Satellite Systems, MDA Space


- Krupal Patel, Senor Director, National Security Space Business Development, Intuitive Machines


- Trey Pappas, Chief Revenue Officer, Cesium Astro


- Cesar Carmona, Principal, Novaspace


Learn more about the event and register by visiting the event website.
